scope: bisect inside 0x5B2C10 with a second counter

setup.0x5B2F43: second counter stub installed (counts how far execution gets)

result: the client died during the call again, and BOTH counters live in process memory -- they vanished with the process, so nothing could be read.
lesson: in-memory counters are useless when the target process dies. Bisecting inside 0x5B2C10 must use a mechanism that survives the death: either the launcher's one-shot breakpoints (which record hits outside the process) or a stub that writes progress to a file/pipe.
